h: Before you step into the box
p: A little preparation makes all the difference. Turn up in trainers and comfy clothes, as you'll be moving, reaching and darting around. Arrive a few minutes before your slot so there's time for the briefing, and agree among yourselves who's doing what. Splitting roles, whether that's targets, puzzles or shouting out the timer, almost always beats everyone charging at the same wall at once.

Sessions run for set lengths and the game choice rotates, so look at what's on when you book. Some games suit families with younger players, while others are better for teens and adults who want something faster. If you're bringing a mixed-age group, it pays to pick something everyone can enjoy rather than the scariest option on the menu.

Wandsworth has some interesting history to explore too. The old Ram Brewery, where Young's beer was brewed for generations, brewed beer for centuries and is now part of a big riverside redevelopment. The River Wandle, which gave the area its name, flows through on its way to the Thames, and there are stretches of the Wandle Trail you can walk.

Further afield, Battersea Power Station has been turned into a shopping and food destination with lifts up one of its famous chimneys, and Wimbledon, with its common and tennis museum, is only a short hop south-west. Plenty to stretch a session into a full south London day.
